description: Anode notation vectors (docs/notation/README.md, "Vectors"): MIDI notes of one region at tick 0 on one track with a staff style and region notation settings in; the measures and every voice's events out, as the notation engine renders them. Ticks are 960 PPQ project ticks; written pitches use scientific octaves (C4 is MIDI 60); staff positions are diatonic steps above the bottom line (MEI loc); voices count from 1 within a staff, staves from 0. A case with part true is rendered as the track's extracted part (written at transposed pitch); otherwise as the full score at concert pitch.
